recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7061 unless a future work group decision changes MIME type validation policy.
issue_request: FHIR-7061 was a Published FHIR-core Binary change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking whether a MIME type value set/list could be added because required MimeType validation was unclear. The final resolution was to state explicitly in the MimeType binding definition that "Any valid mime type is allowed".
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git-svn commit b31ccc01d20b3e408d2f368a0c2720b376f26f99, whose message references #7061 and svn revision 6427 and which added the "Any valid mime type is allowed" wording to the shared MimeType binding in source/terminologies/bindings.xml. Later source refactoring propagated that binding into the current Binary StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Binary is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the mimetypes value set is also actively configured there. Current source/binary/structuredefinition-Binary.xml binds Binary.contentType to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/mimetypes with the requested binding-definition wording, while source/terminologies/valueset-mimetypes.xml defines that value set as all BCP-13 codes. Jira neighborhood, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for this Binary MimeType request.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source already satisfies the 2015 resolution.
